tweets.text: If the values are equal it's always better for a spinner to take the NFT because there's no fee on it, and then the challenge is to liquidate it for more than ETH value -15%. So depositors doing this incentivize spinning because it increases EV. It would mean more volume for the protocol to generate fees but this is a sort of tragedy of the commons. If you whack in a large position on a random NFT you can farm with the 1% bonus with minimal capital allocated, but you're also decreasing EV for everyone AND making the top prize look boring which is important here imo. Whitelisting helps this a little bit but is not a complete solution. So how do we get people to price equal or lower to their NFT? The protocol already uses Chainlink oracles so it is not impossible to gate deposit valuations in a suggested range per collection :) requires a little governance but some curation would solve all of this.
